runtimePolicy: No candidate is loaded by the application until scientific, provenance, entry-specific license, visual, and offline-asset reviews are all complete and recorded. Repository presence (NIH 3D, RCSB) is never itself an approval: NIH 3D terms require independent verification of scientific conclusions and entry-specific licensing.

candidates.fit: Biomedical cell and organelle models may provide candidate geometry for a future conceptual cell reference.

scientific.note: Model provenance, scale, organelle labeling, and topology must be checked per entry.

provenance.note: A specific versioned entry with creator and dataset citation is required.

license.note: Entry-specific license review required; repository terms note that licenses vary by entry.

visual.note: Human visual review of geometry quality and educational scope.

offline.note: Local packaging and offline redistribution rights must be confirmed.

candidates.fit: Molecular 3D structures could support a future molecule-scale supplement, not a whole-cell anatomy reference.

scientific.note: Atomic or molecular structures must not be presented as a complete cell.

provenance.note: PDB entry, resolution, and method must be recorded.

license.note: Archive and entry terms must be checked for each selected structure and attribution.

visual.note: Representation style must be reviewed for educational clarity.

offline.note: Static local export must replace any runtime viewer dependency.

candidates.fit: Biomedical tissue or body-part models may provide candidate macro geometry for a future tissue-context view.

scientific.note: Histology scale, tissue identity, and source annotations must be reviewed by an expert.

provenance.note: A specific versioned entry with creator and dataset citation is required.

license.note: Entry-specific license review required; repository terms note that licenses vary by entry.

visual.note: Human visual review of geometry quality and educational scope.

offline.note: Local packaging and offline redistribution rights must be confirmed.

candidates.fit: DNA, RNA, and protein structures could support a molecular-scale heredity supplement.

scientific.note: Molecular structure is not a chromosome-scale inheritance map or a trait predictor.

provenance.note: PDB entry, resolution, and method must be recorded.

license.note: Archive and entry terms must be checked for each selected structure and attribution.

visual.note: Representation style must be reviewed for educational clarity.

offline.note: Static local export must replace any runtime viewer dependency.

candidates.fit: DNA or molecule models may be candidates for a symbolic 3D supplement.

scientific.note: Scientific scope and educational labeling must be reviewed before use.

provenance.note: A specific versioned entry with creator and dataset citation is required.

license.note: Entry-specific license review required; repository terms note that licenses vary by entry.

candidates.provider: Authored in-house (Human Biology Lab), procedural articulated performance rig
candidates.fit: In-sandbox v1 performance body (D6): realistic-proportioned articulated teaching figure with named muscle meshes; photoreal upgrade path is MakeHuman (D1).

scientific.note: G1: proportions, joint ROM, muscle origin/insertion plausibility per docs/KINESIOLOGY_SCIENTIFIC_INSPECTION.md.

provenance.note: Authored in-sandbox; chain recorded in vendor/kinesiology/PROVENANCE.json.

license.note: CC0-equivalent (in-house authored); confirm no third-party geometry incorporated.

visual.note: Human visual review of figure quality, muscle placement, and disclosures per camera preset.

offline.note: Procedural (no download); cache budget to be recorded in Phase 72.

candidates.provider: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database, via lawrennd/mocap GitHub mirror (BVH conversions)
candidates.fit: Real captured human locomotion trials to retarget onto the performance rig; CMU acknowledgment shipped (D4).

scientific.note: G1: clip content identification, cadence/ROM vs published gait data, retarget artifact review.

provenance.note: Mirror checksums recorded at download; primary host unreachable from sandbox (environment log).

license.note: CMU classic terms: inclusion allowed with acknowledgment; no raw/converted resale; embed-only.

visual.note: Human visual review of retargeted motion quality.

offline.note: Baked derived clips packaged locally; raw files never served.

candidates.fit: Production photoreal upgrade: CC0 skinned body + muscle layer on one rig (D1). Not executable in sandbox.

scientific.note: G1 in production environment before any use.

provenance.note: Record toolchain + asset versions at production run.

license.note: CC0 per MakeHuman core-assets FAQ; verify per-file at production run.

visual.note: Human visual review of produced rig.

offline.note: Draco GLB budget review at production run.
